rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when parts or members make up a whole, group, or structure.

example.english: These departments constitute the core of the company.
example.traditional: 呢幾個部門組成公司嘅核心。
example.jyutping: nei1 gei2 go3 bou6 mun4 zou2 sing4 gung1 si1 ge3 hat6 sam1

rows.note: Use this for setting up an organization, company, committee, or similar body.

example.english: Today, we constitute a new committee.
example.traditional: 我哋今日成立新委員會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 sing4 lap6 san1 wai2 jyun4 wui2

rows.note: Use this specifically when an authority enacts or formulates a law, rule, or policy.

example.english: The government's decision to constitute this policy is meant to protect the public.
example.traditional: 政府制定呢套政策，係為咗保障市民。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 zai3 ding6 nei1 tou3 zing3 caak3 hai6 wai6 zo2 bou2 zoeng3 si5 man4
